summary: Umami is a self-hosted web analytics platform: users authenticate and create website/pixel/link tracking entities (or team-scoped ones), a public /api/send ingest endpoint records pageviews/custom events/session-identify/performance rows and session/session-data/session-link/revenue rows, a public /api/record endpoint stores session-replay and heatmap events, and a large read layer serves analytics queries (metrics, sessions, events, reports, funnels, boards, shares) back over those persisted rows.
